headline: PhysicsWallah sells its FinZ Finance loan portfolio of Rs 95.79 crore to Auxilo Finserve
hook: Fintech pivot abandoned for edtech core
summary: Edtech unicorn PhysicsWallah has sold its entire loan portfolio of Rs 95.79 crore, managed under its in-house lending arm FinZ Finance, to NBFC Auxilo Finserve. The move signals a strategic retreat from direct consumer lending back to its core educational business. FinZ Finance was initially positioned to offer credit solutions to students for course fees. For Indian retail investors, this highlights the regulatory hurdles and capital intensity of captive lending models for edtech firms.
why_it_matters: Edtech firms exit direct lending amid tightening regulatory norms.
winners_losers: Auxilo Finserve gains / Edtech lenders hurt
